image_description: A white minibus parked on a paved brick surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of side windows, and a front engine compartment typical of van-based minibuses. There is a logo or decal on the hood and some text/graphics on the rear side window. The background includes a building with scaffolding or fencing and some greenery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from full-size buses but taller than standard vans, matching the minibus profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with multiple side windows indicating a passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width, and the driver/passenger door configuration is visible at the front.
The track and handle mechanism for a sliding door are visible on the side panel behind the front door.
The short hood and grille area indicate a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame or obscured by the angle; only the side and front-quarter are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with visible decals/logos on the hood and side, consistent with commercial livery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle body, appearing as standard steel rims with hubcaps.
The window count and overall dimensions align with the capacity of a 4-10 passenger minibus.

artifact_observations.location: Hood decal and rear side window
artifact_observations.reasoning: The logo on the hood is indistinct and lacks clear typographic structure. The text/graphic on the rear side window appears smeared and illegible, a common artifact in AI-generated vehicles where text rendering fails.
The side mirror housing blends slightly into the door frame without a sharp mechanical separation line. The door handles appear somewhat soft and lack precise mechanical definition.

The curve of the front wheel arch and the alignment of the bumper near the headlight show slight geometric inconsistency, appearing slightly warped rather than following a rigid industrial design line.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly conforms to the 'minibus' class. All testable geometry and functional checkpoints (boxy shape, windows, sliding door, engine compartment) are present and accurate. The only untestable checkpoint was the rear view due to framing. Class conformance is excellent.
artifact_reasoning: While structurally sound, the image exhibits minor AI artifacts. Primary issues are illegible/gibberish text on decals and windows (severity ~1.5) and slight softness/blending in mechanical details like mirrors and handles (severity ~1.2). These prevent a perfect quality score but do not detract significantly from the overall realism.
